description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Jugan.
Jugan dies, triggering itself and Nim Deathmantle.
Resolve the Jugan trigger, putting five +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return Jugan from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.
